title: Oregon vs Michigan State: 2nd Half Point Total

contracts.label: More than 30.5 points scored in the 2nd half

content.value: This market resolves to Yes if Oregon and Michigan State collectively score more than 30.5 points during the 2nd half of the College Football game between Oregon and Michigan State scheduled for November 20, 2026 at 8:00 PM ET. Otherwise, it resolves to No. The Underlying is the total points scored by both teams during the 2nd half of the specified game, excluding all other periods and overtime.
